intelligence.human_view: He said it twice in one night — first on the deploy ("find the cause first, then retry"), then on the Dashboard card — and both times the discipline is the same: do not drive into the broken road again, find out why it is broken first. This time the cause was found, and it was the old one, wearing a wider coat: the filter that blocks writable file-backed shared memory mappings, now covering all three paths instead of one. The timeline is the proof that a single green probe means nothing — alive at 03:02Z, dead again by 03:04Z, a two-minute window that would have swallowed any eye dispatched on it. So the retry condition is now exact and fourfold: all eight mappings, a real launch with a real PNG, the same result again five minutes later, and a re-test at the door. Until then, no VM eye is dispatched, and the cloud browser carries the walks. Cause first is not slowness; it is the thing that stops seven identical failures from becoming eight.
intelligence.simple_view: Imagine the front door keeps sticking, and every time you just push harder. Shawn says: stop pushing — find out WHY it sticks first. So we looked, and the reason is the same as before, only worse now: the house won't let the browser open its shared notebook. And one time the door opened for two minutes and then stuck again — so one lucky opening doesn't mean it's fixed. Now the rule is: it has to open twice, five minutes apart, with a real picture to prove it — only then do we try the walk again.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, Shawn tapped the button that says find the cause first, then retry, dear — and that's exactly right. We looked properly this time, dear, and the cause is the same old one, only spread wider now: the machine won't let the browser open its shared notebook. And one morning it worked for just two minutes and then stopped again, dear — so one lucky try doesn't mean it's fixed. Now we only try again when it works twice, five minutes apart, with a real picture to prove it, dear. Until then, we use the other way in.
intelligence.naya_view: FIND THE CAUSE FIRST, THEN RETRY. THE CAUSE IS CONFIRMED — THE SHARED-MEMORY FILTER, WIDENED. A SINGLE ALIVE PROBE IS NOT GREEN. TWO GREEN PROBES, FIVE MINUTES APART, OR NO VM EYE.
